shots.note: medium push_in: Shiva runs in fear across the Kailash snow with his hair and tiger skin flying and a worried face; the title card sits above him.
medium tilt_up: Bhasmasura raises his glowing right hand and stares with red eyes; ash grey sparks drift off his hand on 'ash'.
two_shot dolly_right: Vishnu stands calm in a golden light with a hand raised in protection while Shiva stands anxious beside him.
close push_in: A close Vishnu with a sly quiet smile and eyes glancing sideways, a pale halo behind his head.
medium static: Vrikasura, a thin ascetic demon with small horns and matted hair, stands with folded hands and a humble face; his name appears on 'Vrikasura'.
two_shot dolly_left: Narada with his veena smiles and points a finger up toward the sky while Vrikasura listens with folded hands, nodding.
medium push_in: Vrikasura sits cross-legged with closed eyes and folded hands in deep prayer while fallen leaves drift by to show passing years.
medium pull_out: Vrikasura opens his eyes with a sad hurt face, then lifts a sword toward his body on 'cutting' in a grim, desperate pose.
two_shot push_in: Vrikasura holds the sword level at his own neck at the left while Shiva steps in from the right and grips his arm with a firm calm face.
medium dolly_right: Vrikasura kneels and pleads with open eyes and hands pressed together, looking up at Shiva.
medium tilt_up: The demon points a glowing hand at his own head, ash-grey light and drifting sparks around it, with a greedy smile.
medium pull_out: Shiva frowns with worried eyes and a raised hand, shaking his head slowly at the demand.
medium push_in: Vrikasura clasps his hands and looks up with a pleading smile that shows devotion, a light glow around him.
medium tilt_down: Shiva lowers his head in a slow sad nod with one open hand giving the blessing, light spilling from his palm.
medium push_in: The ascetic now stands as Bhasmasura with horns, red eyes and ash streaks and a glowing right hand, his name on the screen as a violet swirl rises.
medium dolly_right: Parvati in a red sari with a lotus walks gently along a green hillside with a calm face; her name is on the screen.
medium push_in: Bhasmasura stares with wide red eyes toward the right, his mouth slightly open and his eyes fixed on her.
close crane_down: A close bust of Bhasmasura with a dark angry scowl and a sly sideways glance as the thought forms; red glow behind his head.
medium tilt_up: Bhasmasura lifts his glowing right hand high above his head with a wild grin, ash-grey light flaring from his palm.
medium dolly_left: Shiva leans away in alarm with hands out and then turns into a run with his hair streaming; a gust of dust behind him.
wide pan_right: Shiva sprints across a red desert road with his hair and tiger skin flying; speed dust streams behind him.
two_shot dolly_right: Shiva runs at the left and glances back over his shoulder in terror while the demon, a smaller figure with a glowing hand, follows close behind at the right.
wide crane_up: Shiva, exhausted, stands small at the gates of golden Vaikuntha with the golden palace and milk ocean ahead; the name Vaikuntha appears.
two_shot push_in: Shiva pleads with pressed hands and a frightened face before Vishnu, who stands calm and listening at the right.
two_shot static: Vishnu dissolves into a bright flash of gold light and swirling shimmer, fading out as Shiva watches with wide eyes.
medium push_in: Mohini, blue-skinned in a red sari with garland and crown, stands in a graceful dance pose in the golden light, her name appearing on 'Mohini'.
medium dolly_right: Bhasmasura gazes dreamily at Mohini with a soft goofy smile, his glowing hand hanging down, forgotten.
medium pull_out: Mohini beckons with an open hand and a bright smile, her sari swaying in a dance pose.
two_shot static: Stacked: Mohini above puts her hand on her head in the dance; below the demon copies her and touches his own head with his glowing hand.
medium orbit: Mohini spins in a joyful dance beside a heap of grey ash where the demon stood, and grey flakes drift in the golden light.
medium dolly_left: Shiva stands with a worried face looking back at the empty path, one hand open, and a faint grey spark glows in the air where the gift hung.
two_shot pull_out: Vishnu and Shiva stand together in golden light, Vishnu with a calm smile and Shiva relaxed with a thankful face.
